tell: Barley grows where nothing better will — high, cold, far from water — and ripens fast, but it never gives what wheat gives on good ground.
suits: 0.8 * (1 - 0.5 * field.flood) * clamp(1.2 - field.damp, 0, 1) * clamp(0.45 + field.snow + 0.3 * (1 - field.sun), 0, 1) * clamp(1 - (parcel.water - 10) / 10, 0.3, 1) * clamp(parcel.elevation / 2, 0, 1)
